how: Read from the pages named below through a web-fetch agent after the calculator and its predictions were committed (4a95943). Figures are as printed, in billions, with the number of decimals printed. The tolerance used by the checks is half a unit of the last printed digit. Where a source prints a coarser figure as well, it is kept under coarser_figures and is not used for the checks.
